title: Out-of-place message in or around the initial key exchange answered with UNIMPLEMENTED, connection kept
quote: Once a party has sent a SSH_MSG_KEXINIT message for key exchange or re-exchange, until it has sent a SSH_MSG_NEWKEYS message, it MUST NOT send any messages other than ...
rationale: During the initial KEX: duplicate KEXINIT or SR_AUTH/SR_CONN/UA_PW_OK answered with UNIMPLEMENTED; after it: KEX30 or NEWKEYS outside any KEX answered with UNIMPLEMENTED; connection kept (v1 D9: OpenSSH; Dropbear and Go close). Written by proto-sm stream A (v2) from v1 class D9 (report.md); vocabulary: teammate mapper (UNIMPLEMENTED, SERVICE_ACCEPT, CLOSED/NO_CONN, UA_PW_OK). An accepting word is a behaviour witness, not necessarily a bug.
